en: This is a page about Incursions in general. If you are looking to join or just get more information about the EVE University Incursion Community then follow that link, as we have additional roles that do not require any specific skills (which are perfect for new players) and we do things slightly different from public communities to accommodate new players and to account for the fact that we're sometimes at war.
zh: 本页是关于入侵的总体介绍。如果你想加入 EVE University 入侵社区或了解更多相关信息，请点击该链接。我们设有一些不需要特定技能的额外职位（非常适合新玩家），而且为了照顾新玩家，也考虑到我们有时处于战争状态，我们的做法和公开社区略有不同。

blocks.en: What are incursions?
blocks.zh: 什么是入侵？

blocks.en: Incursions are automated events introduced with the Incursion expansion in which the NPC faction known as the Sansha's Nation, led by Sansha Kuvakei, invade space in an attempt to conquer it for themselves. Capsuleers must fight off Sansha's forces in order to return the contested space back into an area which can be more safely occupied.
blocks.zh: 入侵是随入侵（Incursion）版本推出的自动事件，由萨沙·库瓦克（Sansha Kuvakei）领导的 NPC 势力萨沙共和国入侵太空，企图将其据为己有。克隆飞行员必须击退萨沙的部队，才能让被争夺的区域重新变得可以较为安全地活动。

blocks.en: High-end PvE fleet content
blocks.zh: 高端 PvE 舰队玩法

blocks.en: Incursions are high-end PvE fleet content, well above the challenge of regular Level 4 missions and more like Level 5s. The introduction of incursions to the game added an incentive for high-level, coordinated fleet content in highsec space. Incursion PvE combat is also a controlled environment in which players can practice fleet tactics and key fleet roles such as "logistics" (that is, repairing other ships).
blocks.zh: 入侵是高端的 PvE 舰队玩法，难度远超普通的 4 级任务，更接近 5 级任务。入侵的加入为高安空间里高水平、讲究协同的舰队玩法提供了动力。入侵 PvE 战斗也是一个可控的环境，玩家可以在其中练习舰队战术和关键的舰队职责，例如“后勤”（即维修其他舰船）。

blocks.en: Contrary to missions, which normally require active tanks, incursion fleets rely on buffer tanks with high damage resistances and supported by logistics ships. The NPC enemies in incursions use electronic warfare and capacitor warfare. They also use high speed and low signature radii to avoid damage. This forces incursion fleets to develop more complex tactics to win.
blocks.zh: 任务通常需要主动坦克，而入侵舰队则依靠高抗性的缓冲坦克，并由后勤舰船提供支援。入侵中的 NPC 敌人会使用电子战和电容战，还会利用高速和小信号半径来规避伤害。这迫使入侵舰队发展出更复杂的战术才能获胜。

blocks.en: There are restrictions on fleet size in incursions, and so each member of the fleet matters. A lack of skill or an inefficiency cannot be compensated by simply adding more ships. As such, incursion combat is not ideal for the brand new player, but is more geared towards those who've spent at least a few months in the game and are able to fly battleships, logistics or other more advanced ships. EVE University incursion fleets do have some additional roles for low-SP characters, but other groups running incursions may not use these.
blocks.zh: 入侵对舰队规模有限制，因此舰队中的每个成员都很重要。技能不足或效率低下无法靠单纯增加舰船数量来弥补。所以入侵战斗不太适合纯新手，而更适合已经玩了至少几个月、能开战列舰、后勤舰或其他更高级舰船的玩家。EVE University 的入侵舰队确实为低技能点角色设置了一些额外职位，但其他刷入侵的团体可能没有。

blocks.en: Profits
blocks.zh: 收益

blocks.en: Incursions in highsec are a very profitable activity for any pilot based in a community that runs continuous fleets. A normal fleet running vanguard sites can make about 100 million ISK per hour running sites; more advanced fleets have the potential of making 170+ million ISK per hour. Some of the public communities who specialize in and exclusively run the larger headquarter sites can easily break 400+ million ISK per hour. Incursions also give you CONCORD loyalty points, which increases your income even more.
blocks.zh: 对于身处持续组织舰队的社区的飞行员来说，高安入侵是一项非常赚钱的活动。一支普通的刷先锋站点的舰队每小时大约能赚 1 亿 ISK；更高级的舰队有望达到每小时 1.7 亿 ISK 以上。一些专门只刷大型总部站点的公开社区每小时轻松超过 4 亿 ISK。入侵还会给你统合部忠诚点，进一步增加收入。

blocks.en: Third-party tools such as the Incursion ISK/h calculator on Capsuleers.app can estimate your actual ISK per hour, payout per site and session length from a pasted wallet journal.
blocks.zh: 第三方工具，例如 Capsuleers.app 上的入侵 ISK/小时计算器，可以根据你粘贴的钱包日志估算实际的每小时 ISK、每个站点的报酬和单次时长。

blocks.en: See Incursion sites for more details about payouts and about how these sites differ from each other. See Loyalty Points for more information on how to turn loyalty points into items to use or sell.
blocks.zh: 关于报酬以及各站点之间的区别，详见入侵站点。关于如何把忠诚点换成自用或出售的物品，详见忠诚点。

blocks.en: Nomadic in nature
blocks.zh: 游牧性质

blocks.en: Incursions are nomadic by nature, with focus areas lasting anywhere from a day up to over a week, forcing the incursion community to move near-constantly to continue taking part of the content. See Spawning and duration below for more information on the spawn mechanics, or How to find Incursions for more information on how to find and safely move between incursions.
blocks.zh: 入侵天生具有游牧性质，每个焦点区域持续一天到一周多不等，因此入侵社区几乎要不停地迁移才能继续参与。关于刷新机制的更多信息，请参阅下文的“刷新与持续时间”；关于如何寻找入侵并在入侵之间安全移动，请参阅如何寻找入侵。

blocks.en: Incursion communities
blocks.zh: 入侵社区

blocks.en: Since all joining the same corporation or alliance would leave pilots wide open for war declarations, incursion runners remain in their corporations and alliances and instead affiliate themselves with various communities. Most communities operate in the same way: They have a public channel that anyone can join with all the information a pilot might need being available in their channel's message of the day. Fits are usually available through mailing lists or some other repository.
blocks.zh: 由于大家都加入同一个军团或联盟会让飞行员很容易被宣战，刷入侵的玩家会留在各自的军团和联盟里，转而加入各种社区。大多数社区的运作方式相同：都有一个任何人都能加入的公开频道，飞行员需要的所有信息都写在频道的每日消息里。装配通常通过邮件列表或其他资料库提供。

blocks.en: EVE University maintains an active Incursion Community of current members, alumni and their alts. This community is one of the oldest Incursion communities in EVE Online and is one of the only communities to run despite frequent war declarations. This near constant state of war along with a primary focus on teaching has lead to slightly different operating procedures compared to other communities. We also have roles that do not require any specific skills, roles that other communities simply don't need or want. See the EVE University Incursion Community page for more information.
blocks.zh: EVE University 维护着一个由在校成员、校友及其小号组成的活跃入侵社区。这是 EVE Online 中最古老的入侵社区之一，也是少数几个在频繁被宣战的情况下仍坚持运作的社区之一。这种几乎持续不断的战争状态，加上以教学为首要目标，使我们的运作流程与其他社区略有不同。我们还设有不需要特定技能的职位，这些职位其他社区根本不需要也不想要。更多信息请参阅 EVE University 入侵社区页面。

blocks.en: Lore
blocks.zh: 背景故事

blocks.en: CCP has released both the Incursion trailer and the CDIA Files: Sansha Incursions videos concerning Sansha Kuvakei and Incursions. They also made a more cinematic version of Incursions, called Incursion - Cinema Cut.
blocks.zh: CCP 发布了有关萨沙·库瓦克和入侵的入侵预告片和CDIA 档案：萨沙入侵视频，还制作了一个更具电影感的版本，名为入侵 - 影院剪辑版。

blocks.en: From the EVE Chronicle Uplifted:
blocks.zh: 摘自 EVE 编年史《升华》（Uplifted）：

en: Then the wormhole let out a searing burst of white light, and they came through, bulbous metallic vessels covered in wicked, uneven spines. Hundreds poured from the shimmering portal, covering light years of distance in a single instant to cloud the skies above the helpless planet. Almost fishlike, darting in loose formation and changing direction simultaneously, they spread out in all directions. With synchronized releases of focused electromagnetic blasts, they smoothly wiped all defensive structures and communications satellites from orbit. For many people on the surface, the sudden glare of golden laser beams lancing across the night sky was the first sign that Sansha’s Nation had arrived. When it had secured the entire lower orbital altitude, the armada held position until a second wave of ships emerged from the wormhole. These new vessels were different, though, lacking the bulky warp drives that took up so much space in the combat vessels; instead, their cavernous cargo holds had a very specific purpose, housing rows and rows, layer upon layer of holding cells designed to store humanoid “passengers”. The ships dropped through the atmosphere unimpeded, by squadrons, a perfectly orchestrated meteor shower.
zh: 随后，虫洞迸发出一道灼目的白光，它们穿了过来——那是一艘艘球茎状的金属舰船，表面覆盖着邪恶而参差不齐的尖刺。数以百计的舰船从闪烁的传送口中涌出，瞬间跨越数光年的距离，如乌云般笼罩在这颗无助星球的上空。它们几乎像鱼群一样，以松散的队形穿梭，同时变换方向，向四面八方散开。它们同步释放聚焦的电磁冲击，从容地将轨道上所有防御设施和通讯卫星一扫而空。对地面上的许多人来说，金色激光骤然划破夜空的强光，是萨沙共和国降临的第一个信号。在控制了整个低轨道高度之后，舰队保持阵位，直到第二波舰船从虫洞中出现。然而这些新来的舰船有所不同，它们没有战斗舰船上那种占据大量空间的笨重跃迁引擎；取而代之的是巨大的货舱，用途十分明确：里面一排又一排、一层又一层，全是用来关押人形“乘客”的囚室。这些舰船以中队为单位毫无阻碍地穿过大气层，宛如一场精心编排的流星雨。

blocks.en: Effects
blocks.zh: 影响

blocks.en: This incursion information shows in all systems, letting you know there is an incursion going on. It also shows what kind of system it is, the current influence and whether the mothership has been sighted yet.
blocks.zh: 这条入侵信息会显示在所有相关星系中，告诉你这里正在发生入侵。它还会显示星系的类型、当前影响力，以及是否已经发现母舰。

blocks.en: When Sansha's forces place a constellation under siege, the nebula gets a brownish hue making it obvious that something is different; beacons will appear in your overview; rats are replaced; and you suffer system wide penalties, which all make it harder to continue your usual business anywhere in the entire constellation.
blocks.zh: 当萨沙部队围困一个星座时，星云会蒙上一层褐色，明显能看出有异样；总览中会出现信标；怪会被替换；你还会受到全星系范围的惩罚，这些都会让你在整个星座的任何地方都更难照常活动。

blocks.en: You can read more about the actual sites and how many people it takes to run them on the Incursion sites page.
blocks.zh: 关于具体站点以及刷这些站点需要多少人，详见入侵站点页面。

blocks.en: The image to the right is an example of what the information panel might look like. The panel will have different names pending on the style of incursion system. In addition to "Sansha Vanguard", there are also "Sansha Staging" and "Sansha Headquarters". Clicking on the "Incursion Profile" part takes you to the Journal and Loyalty Point Log.
blocks.zh: 右侧图片是信息面板的一个示例。面板名称会因入侵星系类型而不同。除了“萨沙先锋（Sansha Vanguard）”，还有“萨沙集结（Sansha Staging）”和“萨沙总部（Sansha Headquarters）”。点击“入侵概况（Incursion Profile）”部分会打开日志和忠诚点记录。

blocks.en: Once the Sansha forces withdraw from the constellation or the mothership site is finished, the incursion is over; the information panel will then disappear, and things immediately return to normal.
blocks.zh: 一旦萨沙部队撤出星座，或者母舰站点被完成，入侵就结束了；信息面板随之消失，一切立即恢复正常。

blocks.en: Constellation Penalties
blocks.zh: 星座惩罚

blocks.en: During an incursion there are constellation-wide penalties. The strength of the tank and weapon penalties are tied to both the level of activity and how much influence Sansha's forces have in the constellation. As players run sites, the Sansha's influence drops, and most of the penalties drop along with it until they are effectively cancelled at zero influence.
blocks.zh: 入侵期间会有覆盖整个星座的惩罚。坦克和武器惩罚的强度与活跃程度以及萨沙部队在星座中的影响力挂钩。随着玩家刷站点，萨沙的影响力会下降，大部分惩罚也随之降低，直到影响力为零时基本被抵消。

en: System-wide cynosural field jammers are in effect. Cynosural field jamming has no impact in high security space, but can be quite damaging for a nullsec alliance if one of their logistics hubs is locked down. This penalty is absolute and always in effect even at zero influence, but does not stop you from lighting a covert cynosural field.
Financial systems compromised. 50% reduction in CONCORD bounties. The 50% reduction in CONCORD bounties is always in full effect and doesn't scale with Sansha's influence.

Vessel integrity compromised. Shield and armor resistances reduced. At full influence, a ship in a Vanguard system suffers a 10% penalty to resists. In Assaults the penalty is 25% and in Headquarter systems the penalty is a whopping 50% cut in resists. Due to the way resists work, this practically means that a ship with resist of 73% drops to 70% in Vanguard, 66% in Assaults and as low as 59% in Headquarter sites. You do take up to 10%, 25% or 50% more damage depending on the type of system you're in and the level of influence.

Capsule interference detected. Turret, launcher, drone and smartbomb damage reduced. At full influence, player ships deal 10% less damage in Vanguards, 25% less damage in Assaults and as much as 50% less damage in Headquarter sites.
zh: 全星系诱导力场干扰器生效。诱导力场干扰在高安没有影响，但如果 00 区联盟的某个物流枢纽被封锁，就可能造成相当大的损失。这项惩罚是绝对的，即使影响力为零也始终生效，但不会阻止你开启隐秘诱导力场。
金融系统受损。统合部赏金减少 50%。统合部赏金减少 50% 始终完全生效，不随萨沙影响力变化。
舰船完整性受损。护盾和装甲抗性降低。在满影响力时，先锋星系中的舰船抗性降低 10%。突击星系中降低 25%，总部星系中更是降低高达 50%。由于抗性的计算方式，这实际上意味着一艘抗性 73% 的舰船在先锋中会降到 70%，在突击中降到 66%，在总部站点中低至 59%。根据所在星系类型和影响力高低，你受到的伤害最多会增加 10%、25% 或 50%。
检测到太空舱干扰。炮台、发射器、无人机和立体炸弹伤害降低。在满影响力时，玩家舰船在先锋中伤害降低 10%，在突击中降低 25%，在总部站点中降低多达 50%。

blocks.en: These penalties apply to everyone within an incursion constellation regardless of whether or not they are actively resisting Sansha's Nation.
blocks.zh: 这些惩罚作用于入侵星座内的所有人，无论他们是否在积极抵抗萨沙共和国。

blocks.en: Normal NPC spawns replaced
blocks.zh: 普通 NPC 刷新被替换

blocks.en: Whenever a constellation suffers an incursion, the normal "belt rats"--NPC enemies found at asteroid belts--and the rats that spawn in ice belts will be replaced by Sansha Incursion rats. These NPCs will be much stronger, tougher, and deadlier than your run-of-the-mill Sansha Mission rats and mining ships; weaker combat ships will stand no chance against them. The rats that spawn in ice belts tend to be larger cruiser- or even battlecruiser-sized ships.
blocks.zh: 每当一个星座遭到入侵，普通的“矿带怪”（即小行星带中的 NPC 敌人）以及冰矿带中刷新的怪都会被萨沙入侵怪取代。这些 NPC 比普通的萨沙任务怪和采矿船强大、耐打、致命得多；较弱的战斗舰船在它们面前毫无胜算。冰矿带中刷新的怪往往是更大的巡洋舰甚至战列巡洋舰级别的舰船。

blocks.en: All rats in missions and exploration sites rats will remain the same, but if you linger in a completed site or a cleared-out mission pocket for a long time, incursion rats will spawn there.
blocks.zh: 任务和探索站点中的怪都保持不变，但如果你在已完成的站点或已清空的任务口袋里逗留太久，那里也会刷出入侵怪。

blocks.en: Due to the normal rat spawns being replaced and the constellation penalties added, certain activities are disincentivized. For example, it's very inefficient to run missions, because your income from bounties is cut in half. Mining is also unwise, as the belts are now haunted by powerful Sansha's rats, and all static belts in the staging system are turned into Nation Industrial Proxy Staging sites. Exploration however, can often be done without much trouble; just don't linger too long in a finished site as Sansha's rats will eventually spawn there too.
blocks.zh: 由于普通怪的刷新被替换，再加上星座惩罚，某些活动变得不划算。例如，做任务效率很低，因为赏金收入会减半。采矿也不明智，因为矿带里现在游荡着强大的萨沙怪，而且集结星系中所有固定矿带都会变成 Nation Industrial Proxy 集结站点。不过探索通常可以照常进行，没什么麻烦；只是别在完成的站点里逗留太久，因为萨沙怪最终也会在那里刷出来。

blocks.en: The Constellation layouts for Incursions page contains a list of all known Incursion Constellations and third-party pages such as dotlan show active incursions. Although incursions move at random, it is fairly easy to avoid them.
blocks.zh: 入侵星座布局页面列出了所有已知的入侵星座，dotlan 等第三方网页会显示当前活跃的入侵。虽然入侵的移动是随机的，但要避开它们相当容易。

blocks.en: Gate camps in lowsec and nullsec
blocks.zh: 低安和 00 区的星门蹲守

blocks.en: In low and null security space, incursion constellations have Sansha "gate camps". Groups of Sansha Incursion rats linger at gates in these systems, catching unaware pilots. It is easy to mistake these for normal rats and underestimate how tough they are, and how much of a punch they pack. See the anatomy page for a list of warp disruptor-capable incursion rats, or the Sansha's Manual for more information about all of them.
blocks.zh: 在低安和 00 区，入侵星座中会有萨沙的“星门蹲守”。成群的萨沙入侵怪守在这些星系的星门处，专抓不留神的飞行员。很容易把它们误认为普通怪，低估它们有多耐打、打人有多疼。可以查看剖析页面中能跃迁扰断的入侵怪列表，或者参阅萨沙手册了解所有入侵怪的更多信息。

blocks.en: Since Sansha rats are much tougher than normal rats and may prove difficult for lone ships or poorly equipped fleets to handle, and many of them possess near-instalocking and tackling capabilities, inexperienced pilots should avoid incursion systems in low- and null-security space.
blocks.zh: 由于萨沙怪比普通怪耐打得多，单船或装备不佳的舰队可能难以应付，而且其中很多几乎能瞬间锁定并拦截，缺乏经验的飞行员应避开低安和 00 区的入侵星系。

blocks.en: Spawning and duration
blocks.zh: 刷新与持续时间

blocks.en: While it is impossible to predict exactly where a new incursion may occur, or exactly how long it'll last, there are several aspects of their spawn mechanics that are systematic and easy to predict.
blocks.zh: 虽然无法准确预测新的入侵会出现在哪里、会持续多久，但其刷新机制中有几个方面是有规律、容易预测的。

blocks.en: Number of incursions and respawns
blocks.zh: 入侵数量与重新刷新

en: Note:

The Invasion patch on May 28th 2019 made some changes to incursion spawns. It was not properly documented, just mentioned on the Triglavian Incursions support pageno longer available, which stated that changes were "lowering the amount of available Sansha Incursions". It now seems to be the case that that highsec incursions are limited to a single constellation, while low- and nullsec incursions remain the same.
zh: 注意：
2019 年 5 月 28 日的入侵战（Invasion）补丁对入侵刷新做了一些改动。这些改动没有正式说明，只在三神裔入侵的支持页面（现已无法访问）中提到过，称改动是“减少可用的萨沙入侵数量”。现在看来，高安入侵被限制为只有一个星座，而低安和 00 区的入侵保持不变。

blocks.en: There can be up to five incursions up at any given time, one in highsec, one in lowsec, and three in nullsec. When an incursion ends, a new one will spawn in the same type of security space as the one they are replacing. This means that whenever a highsec incursion is despawned, either by a Sansha withdrawal by players finishing the mothership site, a new highsec incursion will soon spawn somewhere else.
blocks.zh: 任何时候最多可以同时存在五个入侵：高安一个、低安一个、00 区三个。一个入侵结束后，会在相同类型的安全区域刷出一个新的入侵来取代它。这意味着每当一个高安入侵消失——无论是萨沙撤退还是玩家完成了母舰站点——很快就会在别处刷出一个新的高安入侵。

blocks.en: The delay between an incursion ending and a new one spawning is 12 to 36 hours according to CCP, but there have been reports of respawns delayed for longer.
blocks.zh: 据 CCP 称，从一个入侵结束到新入侵刷新之间的间隔为 12 到 36 小时，但也有报告称重新刷新的延迟更长。

blocks.en: Constellation layouts
blocks.zh: 星座布局

blocks.en: While the incursions will spawn in a random constellation, the systems of a given constellation will always have the same type of sites. There is only one requirement for a constellation to be a potential incursions constellation: it must have at least 6 systems in the same broad category of security status (high, low, or null). Some systems are also excluded from the "incursion rotation": these tend to be major trade hubs and new player starter systems.
blocks.zh: 虽然入侵会在随机的星座刷新，但给定星座中各星系的站点类型总是相同的。一个星座要成为潜在的入侵星座只有一个条件：它必须至少有 6 个星系属于同一大类安全等级（高安、低安或 00 区）。有些星系也被排除在“入侵轮换”之外：通常是主要的贸易中心和新玩家出生星系。

blocks.en: See constellation layouts for more information on which systems will have vanguard, assault or headquarter sites, to save the trouble of visiting the constellation first.
blocks.zh: 关于哪些星系会有先锋、突击或总部站点，请参阅星座布局，省去先去星座实地查看的麻烦。

blocks.en: Phases of an incursion
blocks.zh: 入侵的阶段

blocks.en: Incursions can theoretically last close to eight days, but practically last less long. They go through three different stages; Established, Mobilized and Withdrawing.
blocks.zh: 入侵理论上可以持续将近八天，但实际上通常没那么久。入侵会经历三个不同阶段：建立、动员和撤退。

en: Stage
Explanation
Incursion established (up to 5 days)

Whenever an incursion spawns, this will be the first stage. Sansha Kuvakei's forces are trying to take control of the systems. While reducing Sansha's influence seems to increase the chance of a this stage lasting longer, the exact mechanics are unknown. This can be as short as a day.
Incursion mobilized (2 full days)

The incursion has been in place for a bit, and Sansha Kuvakei's forces are either getting ready to finish off the incursion or they are losing ground and preparing to withdraw from the constellation. This phase always lasts 48 hours unless someone runs the mothership site prematurely.
Incursion withdrawing (1 full day)

The incursion is ending, either due to Sansha Kuvakei's forces finishing with the constellation, or because the incursion community managed to keep them at bay. If the mothership site is not completed within 24 hours, the incursion simply disappears (and no loyalty points are paid out).
zh: 阶段
说明
入侵建立（最长 5 天）
入侵刷新后总是先进入这一阶段。萨沙·库瓦克的部队正试图控制这些星系。降低萨沙的影响力似乎会提高这一阶段持续更久的几率，但确切机制尚不清楚。这一阶段最短可能只有一天。
入侵动员（整 2 天）
入侵已经持续了一段时间，萨沙·库瓦克的部队要么准备完成这次入侵，要么正在节节败退、准备撤出星座。除非有人提前刷掉母舰站点，否则这一阶段总是持续 48 小时。
入侵撤退（整 1 天）
入侵即将结束，要么是因为萨沙·库瓦克的部队已经处理完这个星座，要么是因为入侵社区成功压制了他们。如果母舰站点在 24 小时内没有完成，入侵就会直接消失（并且不会发放忠诚点）。

blocks.en: Mothership sightings
blocks.zh: 发现母舰

blocks.en: The mothership site can occur as early as within the first established stage; all that is needed is that the influence falls to 0% and a single headquarters site is run. Once the mothership has been sighted, the incursion can be ended by destroying the mothership at any time. However, in high and low security space, there is an additional period in the beginning of a focus wherein the mothership can not spawn. In high security space, the duration is three days. In low security, it is one day. This means that a focus in empire space can be guaranteed to last for as long as those periods, while those in null security space have no guaranteed longevity, other than the brief period before the mothership site is unlocked (which can be mere hours).
blocks.zh: 母舰站点最早可能在第一个建立阶段就出现；只需要影响力降到 0%，并刷完一个总部站点即可。一旦发现母舰，随时都可以通过击毁母舰来结束入侵。不过在高安和低安，焦点区域开始时还有一段额外的时间，在此期间母舰不会刷新。高安这段时间为三天，低安为一天。这意味着帝国区域的焦点区域保证至少能持续这么久，而 00 区的焦点区域除了母舰站点解锁前的短暂时间（可能只有几小时）外，没有任何持续时间保证。

blocks.en: The mothership mechanic gives players some control over when incursions end. The different groups who run incursions don't always agree on what is the most desirable timing.
blocks.zh: 母舰机制让玩家可以在一定程度上控制入侵何时结束。刷入侵的不同团体对什么时候结束最合适，看法并不总是一致。
